Ref: KWD/ADMN/2024/12 dated 12.02.2024

2. The wireless sets and satellite phones shall be tested on every Monday and Thursday. The battery condition of the same shall be checked and recorded in the register maintained at the Range Office.

3. The staff stationed in the interior camps shall be provided with raincoats, torches and first-aid kits. The indent for the same shall reach this office by 15.05.2025.

4. The stream crossings on the patrol routes shall be marked with ropes where necessary. The Range Officers shall personally verify the safety arrangements before the onset of heavy rain.

5. The emergency contact numbers of the Control Room, the nearest Police Station and the Fire and Rescue Services shall be displayed in all camps and Range Offices.

6. The daily situation report shall be sent to this office even if there is no unusual occurrence. The report shall mention the weather condition and the number of staff deployed.

The above instructions may be communicated to all staff members through the wireless network and in writing.
